events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Power
angles.copy: Seventy-five years young! Sending big birthday vibes to the one and only Chrissie Hynde. What's your ultimate Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a rock icon, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Mad For It Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment, solo or Oasis?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks Global James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', which premiered in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, naturally) to 007 and over six decades of iconic espionage. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Imagine A Legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're taking a moment to celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Silly Walks & Big Laughs
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his genius for comedy is timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost a true icon. Remembering the irreplaceable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', featuring tracks like 'Norwegian Wood' and 'Michelle', was released in the UK 61 years ago today.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Vibe
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'! This album truly marked a shift in their sound. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Remembering John
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a visionary. Remembering John Lennon and his profound impact on music and beyond. His message of peace lives on.
